gaps.sentence: There were three ___ (BURGLE) on our street last month.
gaps.explanation: 'Three burglaries' — plural noun for the crime; burglars are people.

gaps.sentence: His ___ (SHORT) of funds forced him to abandon the trip.
gaps.explanation: 'Shortage of funds' — the noun for an insufficient amount.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (DECIDE) to close the factory was announced yesterday.

gaps.explanation: 'Studying management' — the field is called management.

gaps.sentence: He is one of the most ___ (SUCCESS) businessmen in the region.

gaps.explanation: 'Championship victory' — the title/contest, not the person.

gaps.sentence: He spoke ___ (CONFIDENT) in front of the camera.
